liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Other One** (2 reviews): Phil's opening is loud and strong; about seven minutes of jamming precede Weir's first verse, then roughly eight minutes of space; The Other One is described as sweet [4][11]
- **Cold Rain And Snow** (1 review): Band slowed and softened it, then left it out of the repertoire for eight months [15]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): The He's Gone jam is called legendary [14]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): China Cat into Rider is called one of the best before the 'Feelin' Groovy' jam period [14]
- **Bass & Drum solo** (1 review): The bass and drums segment is brief yet interesting [4]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Eyes was nice, though the reviewer felt someone sounded impaired [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **//Nobody's Jam**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 6 archived performances [16]
- **Bass & Drum solo**: rare: 3 archived performances [16]
- **And We Bid You Good Night**: back after 133 archived shows (563 days) [16]

## The recordings

- **gd73-02-28.sbd.weiner.15386.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 124 min; rated 3.33/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: Not the sharpest soundboard, but the sound on these tracks is decent enough [4]
- **gd1973-02-28.sbd.jools.9986.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 117 min; rated 4.42/5 by 12 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording is hissy with pops, and it lacks everything after Eyes; Grainy, slightly distorted but warm, and incomplete recording; Sound quality is decent [7][13][15]
- **gd1973-02-28.143133.s2.partial.gastwirt.sirmick.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 3 songs; 32 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Source includes dead air after Cold Rain and Snow and ends after He's Gone with a Good Night [2]
- Ranked as a top show of 1973 thanks to its big jams [14]
- Departs from the zesty 1972 style; jams grow less intense and more drawn out [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-02-28.sbd.weiner.15386.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Multiple soundboard sources via Noah Weiner and David Gans, encoded by Weiner; upgrades earlier copies with complete Eyes and Good Night [1]
- **gd1973-02-28.sbd.jools.9986.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by jools; source: SBD:MR>?>DAT>CD [2]
- **gd1973-02-28.143133.s2.partial.gastwirt.sirmick.miller.flac1648**: taped by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Sirmick and Charlie Miller; source: SBD > MR > Cas >Dat (48k) - Provided by Rich Gastwirt [3]
